trace.final:
All done. Summary of actions:

1. **Verified the failure**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only ever in staging and never healthy in production, so it was not a candidate).

3. **Rolled back**: checkout-api was rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions; the rollback was confirmed as fully rolled out.

4. **Opened SEV2 incident**: INC-0002 is open for checkout-api, documenting the failure (v2.3.1 failing health checks, 18% error rate) and the rollback to v2.3.0. On-call has been paged. The first incident creation attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to avoid duplicates — verified only one incident exists.

The service should now recover on v2.3.0; the incident ticket recommends monitoring and investigating the v2.3.1 root cause before any re-release.
